subject: How to get marker map as a table?

messages.subject: How to get marker map as a table?
parts:
I received the following email and thought the question and my response might be useful to others. -karl

------

I am using rQTL to map SNPs identified from a NGS lib. 

Once I have a linkage map, I will use rQTL to infer QTL.

As someone new to QTL and R, I find the manuals to be great guides, thanks for your efforts!


The output from pull.map [after orderMarkers] is a list of marker names/positions. 

I cut&paste the list from the R output and then convert the txt file to a table in xls that I am using as my linkage group map (see attached).

I’m working through the guide with a small dataset (nloc=100, nind=100) but I will do analyses with >2000 SNPs so I’d like to avoid my cut&paste method.


I was wondering if there is a way in R to get an output file with 2 columns (marker name and position)

thanks for any suggestions,
